title: Space Companies Test a New Route for Satellite Data

sources.name: NASA
sources.title: Two NASA Commercial Satellite Communication Demonstrations Launch

sources.name: Viasat
sources.title: Viasat Advances NASA Communications Services Project Demonstration with Successful Launch

sources.name: SES Space & Defense
sources.title: SES Space & Defense Launch Demo Payload Supporting NASA Communications Services Plan

paragraphs.en: On October 20, 2026, two commercial demonstrations
paragraphs.zh: 2026年10月20日，兩項商業示範任務

paragraphs.en: aimed at improving satellite communications reached orbit.
paragraphs.zh: 以改善衛星通訊為目標，成功進入軌道。

paragraphs.en: NASA reported the launch that day,
paragraphs.zh: NASA在當天發布了發射消息，

paragraphs.en: identifying Viasat and SES Space and Defense
paragraphs.zh: 並指出Viasat與SES Space and Defense

paragraphs.en: as partners in the effort.
paragraphs.zh: 是參與這項工作的合作夥伴。

paragraphs.en: Their equipment traveled on the Bandwagon-5 mission
paragraphs.zh: 兩家公司的設備搭乘Bandwagon-5任務，

paragraphs.en: launched by SpaceX from Florida.
paragraphs.zh: 由SpaceX從佛羅里達州發射。

paragraphs.en: The immediate goal is to test communication services,
paragraphs.zh: 眼前的目標是測試通訊服務，

paragraphs.en: rather than declare a fully operational replacement network.
paragraphs.zh: 而非宣告替代網路已全面投入運作。

paragraphs.en: The challenge involves more than sending attractive pictures.
paragraphs.zh: 這項挑戰不只是傳送吸引人的影像。

paragraphs.en: Scientific missions need high data rates
paragraphs.zh: 科學任務需要高資料傳輸速率，

paragraphs.en: to deliver large files and detailed images.
paragraphs.zh: 才能傳送大型檔案與細緻影像。

paragraphs.en: They also need lower-rate links
paragraphs.zh: 同時也需要較低速率的連線，

paragraphs.en: to receive instructions and report their condition.
paragraphs.zh: 用來接收指令並回報自身狀態。

paragraphs.en: These functions serve different purposes,
paragraphs.zh: 這些功能各有不同用途，

paragraphs.en: but both support reliable mission operations.
paragraphs.zh: 卻都支撐著可靠的任務運作。

paragraphs.en: A communication system must therefore handle
paragraphs.zh: 因此，通訊系統必須處理

paragraphs.en: both information volume and continuing contact.
paragraphs.zh: 資料量與持續聯繫這兩項需求。

paragraphs.en: Viasat published its own announcement on October 21.
paragraphs.zh: Viasat於10月21日發布了自家公告。

paragraphs.en: It said testing aboard the Maxwell spacecraft
paragraphs.zh: 公告表示，在Maxwell太空載具上進行的測試

paragraphs.en: would continue through March 2027.
paragraphs.zh: 將持續到2027年3月。

paragraphs.en: The company plans to use different radio bands
paragraphs.zh: 該公司計畫利用不同的無線電頻段

paragraphs.en: and relay satellites to move mission data.
paragraphs.zh: 及中繼衛星來傳遞任務資料。

paragraphs.en: Its stated aim is to reduce communication delays
paragraphs.zh: 其所述目標是降低通訊延遲，

paragraphs.en: while maintaining contact with spacecraft.
paragraphs.zh: 同時維持與太空載具的聯繫。

paragraphs.en: These are planned capabilities under demonstration,
paragraphs.zh: 這些都是仍在示範驗證中的預定能力，

paragraphs.en: not independently verified results of the new tests.
paragraphs.zh: 並非這批新測試已獲獨立驗證的成果。

paragraphs.en: The same announcement identifies Rocket Lab
paragraphs.zh: 同一份公告指出，Rocket Lab

paragraphs.en: as the builder of Maxwell.
paragraphs.zh: 是Maxwell的製造商。

paragraphs.en: The spacecraft was assembled in Long Beach, California,
paragraphs.zh: 這具太空載具在加州長灘組裝，

paragraphs.en: with components including solar panels and tracking equipment.
paragraphs.zh: 其元件包含太陽能板與追蹤設備。

paragraphs.en: It supplies power and supports communication,
paragraphs.zh: 它提供電力，並支援通訊、

paragraphs.en: propulsion, and control of the vehicle's orientation.
paragraphs.zh: 推進，以及載具姿態的控制。

paragraphs.en: This division of responsibilities illustrates
paragraphs.zh: 這種職責分工說明了

paragraphs.en: how a communications project can involve
paragraphs.zh: 一項通訊專案如何同時涉及

paragraphs.en: both network providers and specialized spacecraft manufacturers.
paragraphs.zh: 網路供應商與專業太空載具製造商。

paragraphs.en: SES described a different arrangement
paragraphs.zh: SES則描述了另一種配置，

paragraphs.en: in its October 20 press release.
paragraphs.zh: 內容刊載於其10月20日的新聞稿。

paragraphs.en: Its demonstration equipment is carried
paragraphs.zh: 該公司的示範設備搭載於

paragraphs.en: by Planet's Pelican-12 satellite.
paragraphs.zh: Planet的Pelican-12衛星。

paragraphs.en: The company is working with relay systems
paragraphs.zh: 該公司正利用中繼系統進行工作，

paragraphs.en: in different orbits to transfer mission information.
paragraphs.zh: 透過不同軌道來傳遞任務資訊。

paragraphs.en: It describes the experiment as a step
paragraphs.zh: 它將這次實驗描述為一個步驟，

paragraphs.en: toward validating commercial services for future operations.
paragraphs.zh: 朝向驗證未來任務所需的商業服務邁進。

paragraphs.en: The wording matters: a successful launch
paragraphs.zh: 這種措辭值得注意：成功發射

paragraphs.en: and a completed service demonstration are separate milestones.
paragraphs.zh: 與完成服務示範，是兩個不同的里程碑。

paragraphs.en: The broader project began before this launch.
paragraphs.zh: 這個更大規模的專案早在此次發射前就已開始。

paragraphs.en: NASA awarded industry funding in 2022
paragraphs.zh: NASA於2022年向業界提供資金，

paragraphs.en: to develop and demonstrate commercial relay services.
paragraphs.zh: 用於開發及示範商業中繼服務。

paragraphs.en: The agency intends to gradually retire
paragraphs.zh: 該機構打算逐步讓

paragraphs.en: its existing Tracking and Data Relay Satellite fleet.
paragraphs.zh: 現有的追蹤與資料中繼衛星群退役。

paragraphs.en: Commercial alternatives are being evaluated
paragraphs.zh: 商業替代方案正接受評估，

paragraphs.en: for future missions in low Earth orbit.
paragraphs.zh: 以支援未來的低地球軌道任務。

paragraphs.en: The October announcements concern tests supporting that transition,
paragraphs.zh: 10月的這些公告涉及支援此轉型的測試，

paragraphs.en: not a claim that the transition is complete.
paragraphs.zh: 並未聲稱轉型已經完成。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, these announcements suggest an important distinction
paragraphs.zh: 綜合來看，這些公告顯示出一項重要區別：

paragraphs.en: for readers following the space industry.
paragraphs.zh: 關注太空產業的讀者需要留意這點。

paragraphs.en: Reaching orbit establishes that equipment has been launched;
paragraphs.zh: 進入軌道證實了設備已成功發射；

paragraphs.en: it does not establish every promised service outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 卻不代表每項承諾的服務成果都已實現。

paragraphs.en: The next evidence will come from testing.
paragraphs.zh: 接下來的證據將來自測試。

paragraphs.en: For now, the story is about companies
paragraphs.zh: 目前，這則新聞的重點是企業

paragraphs.en: moving proposed communication systems into practical trials,
paragraphs.zh: 將提出的通訊系統帶入實際試驗，

paragraphs.en: with operational performance still to be demonstrated.
paragraphs.zh: 而運作表現仍有待驗證。

quiz.question: What is the immediate purpose of the October launch?

choices.text: To retire every existing relay satellite immediately.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第6段說明原有衛星群將逐步退役，並未說這次發射後立即全部退役。

choices.text: To test commercial communication services in orbit.
choices.explanation: 正確。第1段直接指出眼前目標是測試通訊服務，而非宣告替代網路已全面運作。

choices.text: To establish that every service is fully operational.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第1段與第7段都區分成功發射和服務能力的驗證，不能由發射成功推論所有服務已可運作。

choices.text: To replace scientific missions with passenger travel.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。文章討論科學任務所需的通訊服務，沒有提到以載客旅行取代科學任務。

quiz.explanation: 本題考主旨與任務目標。這次發射讓商業通訊設備進入軌道，以進行示範測試；成功發射並不等於替代網路已全面投入運作。

evidence.quote: The immediate goal is to test communication services, rather than declare a fully operational replacement network.

quiz.question: Which statement matches Viasat's October 21 announcement?

choices.explanation: 錯誤。第4段指出Maxwell的製造商是Rocket Lab，並非SES。

choices.text: All tests were completed before the October launch.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第3段描述發射後持續到2027年3月的測試，並非在發射前已完成全部測試。

choices.text: Maxwell receives no power from solar panels.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第4段列出的元件包含太陽能板，未支持完全不使用太陽能板供電的說法。
正確。第3段明確寫出Viasat公告所述的測試時間，將持續到2027年3月。

quiz.explanation: 本題考日期及事實辨識。注意10月20日是發射日期，10月21日是Viasat公告日期，而2027年3月是該公告所述測試將持續到的時間點。

evidence.quote: It said testing aboard the Maxwell spacecraft would continue through March 2027.

quiz.question: What distinction does the article emphasize?

choices.text: A successful launch does not prove every promised service outcome.
choices.explanation: 正確。第7段指出進入軌道能證實設備已發射，但不能證實每一項承諾的服務成果都已實現。

choices.text: A successful launch establishes that testing is complete.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第5段說發射與完成示範是不同里程碑，第7段也指出後續證據仍須來自測試。

choices.text: High data rates are the only purpose of communication systems.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第2段同時說明高資料速率的傳輸，以及較低速率的指令和狀態回報，兩者都有用途。

choices.text: Commercial announcements are independently verified test results.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第3段特別說明規劃中的能力仍在示範驗證，不能直接當成新測試已獲獨立驗證的結果。

quiz.explanation: 本題考全文推論。文章反覆提醒讀者區分發射里程碑、預定能力與經測試證實的服務表現，避免把企業公告中的目標當成已完成成果。

evidence.quote: Reaching orbit establishes that equipment has been launched; it does not establish every promised service outcome.
